plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with a simple once-weekly full-body session that fits a 30-minute cap and bodyweight-only equipment. Week 1 establishes baseline performance on the main lower-body lift so future progress can be tracked, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The focus here is safe beginner strength and power development with low-complexity jumps, push-pull balance, trunk work, and brief conditioning that does not add unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength and low-impact power with simple bodyweight work and clean technique.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same key patterns with slightly harder variations and tighter quality standards.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place while making the work faster, sharper, and more boxing-supportive.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land quietly. Reset between reps and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the countermovement jump feels uncoordinated. Start from a short pause and jump straight up.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use Week 1 to establish your baseline. Warm up with easy bodyweight sets, then perform one hardest clean set per side with a 3-second lower and full control. Stop when form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard set of 4-6 reps per side with strict control. Log reps and whether you completed both sides cleanly so the app can track your baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean set per side with the same tempo and depth each time.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if setup space is limited. Keep the same slow lower and full range.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if rear-foot-elevated work irritates the hips or balance is poor.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve. Keep ribs down, body straight, and chest moving as one piece.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, table, or sturdy surface if floor reps are not yet clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need a simpler variation and keep the torso braced.

exercises.name: Towel Row
exercises.notes: Use a sturdy anchor point. Pull elbows back, pause briefly at the top, and keep the body rigid.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure doorway setup and keep the movement smooth and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have a stable table and can maintain a straight body line.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the lower back gently pressed down and breathe behind the brace.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold is too hard. Move slowly and keep the trunk locked in.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Tempo Rounds
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed and snappy. Keep footwork light and technique clean without turning this into a hard conditioning test.

endurancePrescription.rest: 30 seconds easy walk and breathing reset

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you feel more coordinated from a paused start.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if balance is still the main limiter.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the rear-foot-elevated position is awkward or uncomfortable.

exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve. Press fast from the bottom without losing body line.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if needed and keep the torso braced.

exercises.name: Towel Row

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup and keep the angle manageable.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have a stable table and enough room to row cleanly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the whole foot, keep hips level, and pause for a second at the top.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Leg Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg control is not there yet.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Hold tension through the trunk and keep breathing small and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you cannot keep the lower back down in the hold.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Tempo Rounds
exercises.notes: Move smoothly and stay technically sharp. This should build rhythm, not leave you flat.

endurancePrescription.rest: 30 seconds easy walk and breathing reset

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
